tasks.short: Read plans and select appropriate insulation

steps.what: Read blueprints and assess space characteristics and required thermal performance
Select appropriate insulation based on the space and material heat retaining or excluding characteristics

tasks.design: Keep blueprint interpretation and insulation selection human, using current project and material specifications in {DOCS}. The worker checks the space constraints and documented material characteristics, referring unresolved design questions to the existing responsible specialist.
tasks.previous_blocker: A thermal value alone does not establish that a material fits the particular space and project requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Current native project documents and manufacturer specifications can support the decision without an automated suitability score.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete drawings, constrained spaces and interactions with the wider building design need practical judgement and clarification.
tasks.human_edge: The worker recognises where the actual space or installation method makes a nominal material choice unsuitable.
tasks.altitude: Plan reading, selection effort and delegated decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Resolve material choices against project constraints

evidence.claim: Insulation selection combines blueprint interpretation, space constraints and documented material properties; no labour saving is claimed for automating that judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is reading plans and selecting insulation, excluding preparing the building design, site measurement, purchasing and physical installation. Existing specialist decisions remain with their current owners.

Project designers produce blueprints and performance requirements; existing site records supply available space information; manufacturers produce material specifications through normal work. Worker reads, checks relevance and records interpreted constraints in s1's 55 hours and selection in s2's 45 hours.

No free structured material suitability, verified cavity dimension or compliance flag is assumed. Missing or conflicting information remains an unresolved question and follows existing manual clarification before a material is accepted; no new measurement or specialist work is transferred by this unchanged proposal.

Try current native document references first. No model, custom calculator, new capture requirement or process is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero. Applicable project and national requirements need customer confirmation.
unknowns: Completeness and currency of project drawings and space records
Which material decisions the worker can make independently
Which specialist must resolve conflicting requirements
research_questions: Can each selected material be traced to the actual space constraints and current project specification?

already_counted.description: Read and interpret plans, check material properties and resolve or escalate selection questions

incremental.description: No changed selection process or new upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact selected insulation specification, project drawing versions, space constraints and resolved questions within delegated authority; changes require renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and incremental focal upkeep=0. Blueprint interpretation and material selection keep full time; no design, measurement or supplier labour is treated as a focal saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The worker retains the same practical responsibility for reading plans and selecting suitable insulation.
reach: Resolve specification uncertainties with construction supervisors
skills_to_grow: Interpret project and material specifications together
Distinguish documented values from site assumptions
Escalate unresolved space or design constraints
role.ambitious_version: Make traceable material choices grounded in the actual space and current design requirements.

job.title: Insulation Workers, Floor, Ceiling, and Wall
